findings.title: View permission grants global group management
findings.body: `canManage()` accepts either `view` or `manage` on the all-groups resource. This method backs `requireManage()` for operations such as creating top-level groups, so an administrator granted only view access to all groups can perform global management operations. Require the `manage` scope here.

findings.title: Group resource IDs are used as membership group IDs
findings.body: `getGroupIdsWithViewPermission()` adds the authorization resource's internal ID, but callers pass this set to user search as group membership IDs. Authorization resource IDs are not the corresponding `GroupModel` IDs, so users granted member-view access through these groups are omitted from filtered user searches and counts. Add the resource name (which represents the group ID) instead, and evaluate the permission against that group ID.
